title: Aligning Large Language Models through Synthetic Feedback

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the reward model's performance against a 'lengthy baseline' that consistently selects the longer response to evaluate whether the model inappropriately prefers longer outputs regardless of their actual quality.
Evaluating response pairs twice with GPT-4 by reversing the order of the answers to account for and mitigate the automated evaluator's inherent preference for the first presented response.
